summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Bob Lyon, an American politician who is a former Kansas State Senator from the city of Winchester. It also notes that he is a civil engineer and a graduate of the University of Virginia and George Washington University.
one_line: Bob Lyon is a former Kansas State Senator from Winchester who is also a civil engineer.
